meta.title: Vladimir Koryagin | Technical Writer & Dev Support Specialist
meta.description: Documentation, grants, video, and dev support for tech companies.

hero.name: Vladimir Koryagin
hero.subtitle: Technical Writer & Dev Support Specialist
hero.description: I make what you're building clear to everyone outside your dev team — investors, users, foundations. Native Russian, professional English. I embed with your engineers and handle the writing: docs first, then investor decks, grants, and more. Open to part-time and project-based work.

story.heading: My Story
story.lead: Several times I've had to master an entirely new field — and each time I did. Interpreting for PepsiCo/Wimm-Bill-Dann boardrooms and McKinsey engagements, and now 3+ years of technical work in web3. I bring real expertise today, plus a proven track record of learning fast whatever comes next.

milestones.title: Translator
milestones.description: Graduated from the Department of Romance and Germanic Languages. Started out translating technical, legal, and marketing texts between Russian and English.

bullets: Translated technical manuals, legal contracts, and marketing copy (RU ↔ EN)
Worked with local and international clients across industries
Built domain expertise in legal and technical terminology

milestones.title: Interpreter at Wimm-Bill-Dann & McKinsey
milestones.description: Moved to Moscow. Did simultaneous and consecutive interpreting at board meetings, investor visits, and consulting sessions.

bullets: Simultaneous and consecutive interpreting at C-level meetings, board sessions, and investor visits
Worked on-site at Wimm-Bill-Dann during PepsiCo acquisition
Interpreted for McKinsey consulting teams in client engagements, including international trips

milestones.title: Team Lead & Senior Translator
milestones.description: Ran a translation team for 10+ years with McKinsey as the main client. Translated engagement documents, compiled research reports, maintained glossaries and brought in cloud translation tools.

bullets: Led a team of 5 translators
Main client: McKinsey & Company (10+ years); other clients: Thales Group, JTI, Mars, Heineken, etc.
Managed the team's translation, proofreading, and editing workflows
Personally translated, proofread, and edited documents alongside the team
Compiled and rewrote extensive research reports (up to 700 pages) for McKinsey
Maintained bilingual glossaries and style guides
Implemented cloud translation tools (Memsource/Phrase)
Ran QA checks and managed deadlines

milestones.title: Dev Support at PointGroup
milestones.description: Switched to tech. Working as part of a dev team at a European Web3 company, writing docs, building doc sites, handling grant applications, communicating with foundations, and recording videos.

bullets: Write technical documentation for Web3 projects (JPool, Alula, SVT)
Build and deploy doc sites with SSG engines (e.g., VitePress) and GitBook
Handle grant applications and communications with Web3 foundations (e.g., Solana Foundation, Stellar, Internet Computer)
Create investor decks, event pitches, one-pagers, and other materials
Produce and publish demo videos and tutorials
Prepare Google Play app listings and metadata management
Organize and maintain team task tracking and project data rooms in Notion

skills.heading: What I Do
skills.lead: Everything a dev company needs besides writing code.

items.title: Embedded into Dev Teams
items.description: I work directly with developers. Comfortable with sprints, Git workflows, and async communication. I keep up with sprint pace and tight deadlines.

items.title: Technical Documentation
items.description: I write and deploy docs with SSG engines (VitePress, Sphinx, Jekyll, etc.) or doc-hosting services like GitBook.

items.title: UX Writing & Microcopy
items.description: I write and edit the text inside your product — button labels, error messages, onboarding flows, empty states, tooltips.

items.title: Localization
items.description: I localize between English and Russian myself, and manage localization into other languages — AI-assisted drafts finalized by native-speaking reviewers.

items.title: Grant Applications
items.description: I produce grant proposals and deliver the milestones foundations require — documentation, videos, technical scope. Contributed to $300K+ in grants won from Solana, Stellar, Internet Computer, and other foundations.

items.title: Investor Materials
items.description: Pitch decks, one-pagers, project blurbs, investor letters, data rooms.

items.title: Technical Diagrams
items.description: I draw architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and system overviews.

items.title: Video Production
items.description: I record and edit tutorial videos, grant demos, and product walkthroughs with motion graphics.

items.title: Blog & Social Media
items.description: I write and edit posts for company blogs, Twitter/X threads, community channels.

items.title: App Store Management
